cards.p: The Hulkster's pumping iron on the beach when one heavy-duty storm interrupts his workout.
Through the rain and wind he hears somebody calling for help, out there in the middle of the ocean!
That storm can do some serious damage to the poor dude stranded on that dinky little raft.
Hulk doesn't hesitate. He bolts down the beach, dives into the waves, and swims into the storm.
"Hold on dude" he shouts. "Here comes the Hulkster to the rescue! Don't worry brother - whoever you are!"
The Iron Sheik is refusing Hulk's help! As soon as he sees Hulk, he wants to kick him off the raft.
"Don't be a dope, Sheik! You're in the middle of a bad storm on a small raft. You're in trouble!"
But the Sheik would rather fight than…WHOAH! Look behind you, Hulk - and look fast!
Suddenly, a giant tidal wave curls over the tiny craft, washing Hulk and the Sheik away.
Where are they now? In some tropical paradise where Hulk and the Sheik do nothing but drink coconut milk?
Not quite. Looks like the Sheik has had enough to drink for awhile!Lucky for him the Hulk stayed on to help.
Not quite. Looks like the Sheik has had enough to drink for awhile!Lucky for him the Hulk stayed on to help.
Instead of being grateful, Sheik tries to blame Hulk for getting them both shipwrecked on the island.
Instead of being grateful, Sheik tries to blame Hulk for getting them both shipwrecked on the island.
"Who are you kidding, dude? If it wasn't for the Hulkster, the Sheik would be wearing seeweed!"
When Hulk tells him they should work together, the Iron Sheik insists on making all the decisions.
But he can't seem to decide what they should do first! When Hulk suggests they look for food.
Sheik says that's just what he was going to say! Pretty good for a dude who gets lost in his own hat!
Hulk leads the way through the jungle. "Coconuts! But how do we get up there and get them?" The Sheik pushes by…
..because he's going to show Hulk how the Iron Sheik gets coconuts. He wraps his arms around the tree…
…and shakes it until he gets them all right - right on top of his iron head! Nice work, Sheik!
After finding some food, it's time to build a shelter. The Sheik starts tugging on a stubborn vine…
…that turns out to be more viper than vine! Let's see the Iron Sheik squirm out of this hold!
Thanks to Hulk Hogan, this viper's finding out how Rock-N-Wrestlers have a swinging time!
It seems like the best thing for the Sheik to do is to take a walk - but he can’t do it without getting lost…
…or worse! You can bet that an Iron Sheik sinks pretty quickly into a pit of quicksand.
Hang on, Sheik! The Hulkster will save you as soon as he runs to a nearby tree and rips off a lifesaving limb.
Just as the Sheik is about to go down for the count, Hulk pulls him out - saving his life again.
Some guys are sore winners! Sheik blames Hulk for everything, and says he's going to set up his own camp!
Everything on that side of the stream is the Hulk's half of the island, and the other half belongs to the Sheik!
Hulk Hogan
Hulk Hogan
Hulk Hogan
Hulk Hogan
But Sheik doesn't watch where he's walking, and instead of stepping into his side of the stream…
…he makes a big splash in the stream! This is no time for swimming, Sheik, you've got to build a hut.
…he makes a big splash in the stream! This is no time for swimming, Sheik, you've got to build a hut.
Hulk stocks his well-built hut with plenty of good food - bananas and fresh fish.
Hulk stocks his well-built hut with plenty of good food - bananas and fresh fish.
Sheik would do the same, but it's hard when a poor dude can’t tie two sticks together!
Seeing Hulk's good work is enough to turn a bad Sheik jealous, and make him search for trouble.
It looks like he's found it with this buzzing beehive. Hulk could be in for one serious surprise.
But so could the Sheik, if he doesn't watch where he's putting his big sneaky foot.
What else would you expect from a Sheik who walks into quicksand and falls into streams?
The Sheik turns out to be his own worst enemy, and his whole beehive of trouble falls right back on his head.
Say one thing for the Sheik - he doesn't give up searching for new ways to cause trouble for Hulk.
This time he's got a gigantic boulder loaded up on a palm tree catapult - "Ready…aim…fire!"
Sheik's aim misses Hulk's hut, lands in a nearby palm tree, and starts back on the rebound.
Sheik has seen his own trouble turn back on him too many times before for him not to recognize it!
Start running, Sheik, 'cause here comes 27 tons of granite trouble!
Whew! A few feet closer and the Sheik would have suffered one heavy-duty headache! Pretty lucky.
Or is it? Looks like that boulder cracked the cliff beneath the Sheik…looks like bye-bye!
There's that heavy-duty headache! And the Sheik wonders how things could get any worse?
How about getting stuck out in the rain without any shelter? Why should Hulk let a creep like the Sheik inside?
Because the Hulkster is one okay dude! But just remember that in his hut, Hulk gives the orders!
Sheik won't argue with that - not when there's a dry hut, a warm fire, and grub to be eaten!
Help yourself, Sheik! But you might have left something for the Hulk - a sardine at least!
Sack time, after a long hard day of island survival. The Sheik might leave Hulk a little room in his own hut!
This could be a rescue ship passing - but only if they see Hulk and the Sheik stranded on the island.
The Sheik spots the ship first but can’t figure out what to do. He wakes up the Hulk and asks for help.
The Sheik spots the ship first but can’t figure out what to do. He wakes up the Hulk and asks for help.
First thing to do is light the signal fire that Hulk built yesterday - while the Sheik was playing with bees!
First thing to do is light the signal fire that Hulk built yesterday - while the Sheik was playing with bees!
Hey Sheik! Maybe you should let Hulk run that flame to the signal fire. After all, you haven't had…
Junkyard Dog
Junkyard Dog
Junkyard Dog
Junkyard Dog
…very much luck running! So the Sheik trips into a puddle and puts out the fire - nice work, Sheik!
Even though there's no sign of a signal fire, the ship's officers notice something from the bridge.
Two wrestler's screaming at each other on the beach: "I'll smash in your face!" "Try it, sausage nose!"
After the rescue, the two wrestlers talk about their island adventure to their friends.
After the rescue, the two wrestlers talk about their island adventure to their friends.
They can imagine that being stranded on an island with the Sheik was no picnic for the Hulk.
They can imagine that being stranded on an island with the Sheik was no picnic for the Hulk.
"If not for me, stupid Hulk Hogan would not last a day on Island! It was me, the Sheik, who…AAAAIEY!!!"
The Sheik gets so involved in his story that he falls off the pier. Maybe the water will refresh his memory!
"Here you go, Sheik. Maybe this time you'll be able to remember who's throwing you the rope!"
Hulk Hogan and the Rock-N-Wrestlers fly into India. They've got a big match in Bombay later that night.
But where's their guide? He was supposed to meet them at the airport. He's not anywhere to be seen.
That's no problem for Captain Lou. He'll pass the time by ordering up a nice big bowl of chicken curry.
"Hey, the food's pretty good around here. Maybe a little on the hot side."
"YEEEOOW!!!" Maybe a lot on the hot side! Look out - here comes one fire-breathing wrestler!
"Whew! I wonder what they've got for dessert in this place." No time, though. Look who's here.
It's Bubar, the Rock-N-Wrestler's faithful guide. He's all set to take them to the Bombay Arena.
On the way, they'll stop in the village of Bangpur and visit Tito's foster kid.
They hop in the Rockin' jeep and zip through the Indian jungle - until they run into trouble. The jeep overheats…
…and they stop at the local water hole, where a family of friendly elephants are happy to share.
When Andre overheats, a playful baby elephant shares his water too! Andre and his little buddy have so much fun…
..they don't want to split up. But the wrestlers have to go. So it's bye-bye for now, little elephant!
The wrestlers continue on through the jungle and into the tiny village of Bangpur.
It's a happy reunion when Tito and Raji meet, but Tito is confused. "I don't understand." he says.
"I've been sending you and your family money for a year, yet you look so needy."
"And I've been sending you farm equipment too. But all your crops have failed. What happened, Raji?"
Raji says all they received were letters and photographs. Tito realizes someone must be hijacking the shipments!
Raji says all they received were letters and photographs. Tito realizes someone must be hijacking the shipments!
When Hulk finds out who's been ripping off Raji's village, he's going to put them down and out for the count!
When Hulk finds out who's been ripping off Raji's village, he's going to put them down and out for the count!
Don't worry about a thing, brothers - Junkyard's got an idea that's guaranteed to nail those jive food-nabbers!
And Hillbilly's got an idea too - he knows enough anout farming to help the villagers get their crops growing!
In the meantime, Captain Lou's got enough grub to keep everybody's belly full! Come and get it!
Iron Sheik
Iron Sheik
Iron Sheik
Iron Sheik
They're off! Raji and his family put their hopes into the hands of the Rock-N-Wrestlers.
Junkyard's plan brings the gang down to the docks, where the big cargo ships come in with supplies.
Hulk puts on a hard hat to operate the heavy machinery that unloads the wooden crates.
Hiding inside a crate, Junkyard gets tossed around like a hunk of jive junk!
Superfly hides away in another crate full of brooms and shovels. He plans on doing some serious cleaning up!
Tito sent word to the village that another shipment of supplies was ready to be picked up.
And now all the Rock-N-Wrestlers have to do is hop into their jeep and follow the truck to the hijackers.
Back at the water hole, somebody's spying on Andre's little buddy and his family. But who?
Poachers! And here they come, aiming their truck right for the family of elephants! RUN!
The little elephant tries his hardest to escape. But looking back, he trips and falls into a pit.
Now that the poachers have trapped him, what do they plan to do with him? What is their evil game?
Now that the poachers have trapped him, what do they plan to do with him? What is their evil game?
In Bangpur, Hillbilly teaches the villagers a few new farming techniques...
In Bangpur, Hillbilly teaches the villagers a few new farming techniques...
…that spread the seeds all over the farm - and all over the farmers!
Captain Lou's fresh veggie burgers! "Step right up and get 'em while they’re hot!" Does Captain Lou have french fries?
Are you kidding? Captain Lou's got everything - fries under his cap, ketchup in his vest and salt in his coat!
From a safe distance, the rest of the Rock-N-Wrestlers watch the cargo truck drive in and out of a waterfall.
"We'll get too far behind if we drive behind the falls", says Hulk. "Take that short cut, and step on it, dude!"
When the cargo truck drives straight into town without stopping, they can’t figure out why nobody hijacked the supplies.
Then the Hulkster checks the back of the truck - empty! "What's the story, dudes? How's they do it?"
Before they can think, the truck speeds out of town - only this time it's not completely empty!
"Let's go dudes! We've got to follow that truck and rescue Raji! We've got to find out what happened!"
But how did the full gargo truck become suddenly so empty? The snswer might lie behind the falls.
A hollow cave - home base of operations for a bunch of low-down hijacking bandits!
And guess what the poachers plan on doing with Andre's little buddy - using him for slave labor!
That crate is especially heavy for the little elephant - because Andre is hiding inside.
He drops the crate and it smashes to pieces. Andre, Junkyard and Superfly leap out to take on the bandits!
Before they can move, the bandits drop a strong net on them - rendering them helpless.
When the bandits lock them in a crate and carry it to the cliff, it looks like a bad end for the wrestlers.
It's a long drop into the hard waters of the raging river below. And even if they survive the fall…
…they've got to outlast a rough ride through dangerous rapids and rocky obstacles.
This is no tag-team match. It's more rockin' than the Rick-N-Wrestlers bargained for!
Up on the ridge, the cargo truck speeds across an old bridge that starts to collapse…
…just as the Rockin' jeep is in the middle. They have to do some serious backward wheeling to beat it.
But they just manage to back off as the ancient bridge collapses into the deep valley.
Big John Studd
Big John Studd
Big John Studd
Big John Studd
Back in the rapid, the boxed wrestlers are crusing towards some heavy-duty waterfalls!
"So long dudes! Hope to see you all in the great big wrestling ring in the sky!"
But wait! It looks like help is on the way! If only the elephants can get to the falls on time.
Yes! It's the same elephant family from before - except they miss the little one. And they want him back!
Yes! It's the same elephant family from before - except they miss the little one. And they want him back!
On the ridge, Hillbilly guides the jeep by following the cargo truck's tire tracks to a dead end at the waterfall.
On the ridge, Hillbilly guides the jeep by following the cargo truck's tire tracks to a dead end at the waterfall.
But what's that noise? It sounds like elephants and machinery - and coming from behind the falls.
All they have to do now is sneak into the cave and pin these suckers. Then Bangpur will have it's supplies.
"Hold it right there, dude! Your little food hijacking game is over!"
Hillbilly's putting you two guys out of this match for the count!
"Stealing food and supplies from poor villagers and then selling them on the black market. You guys are low!"
Raji's so excited to see Tito that trips on a rope. Watch out! He's trapped beneath a heavy crate about to drop!
And here comes a huge elephant, carrying another crate. He can’t see where he's stepping.
"Come on, Amigos! We've got to rescue Raji, fast. Even if it means these bandits might escape!"
Hulk and Hillbilly do their best to hold back the elephant's heavy foot while Tito works at the knot.
Just in time! Tito unties Raji and pulls him to safety just as the second crare drops! They're safe.
But no! The bandits escaped when the wrestlers helped Raji, and now they’re charging on a heard of angry elephants.
The Rock-N-Wrestlers are trapped! This looks like one big match these dudes are not going to win…
…until the Elephant Cavalry comes to the rescue! The elephants pull out the bars and lead the way.
Now the bandits are caught for good. Raji is safe with Tito, with all the food and supplies in the cave.
Now the Rock-N-Wrestlers can help Raji and the villagers of Bangpur to grow their own crops.
And Tito's not the only one with a foster kid! Someday the little elephant may be as big as his uncle Andre.
Watch out, everyone! The streets aren't safe, as this four-wheeler weaves through the city! Who's in control?
Watch out, everyone! The streets aren't safe, as this four-wheeler weaves through the city! Who's in control?
Not the Sheik. He's stuck in the passenger seat as Nikolai drives him crazy. Watch out, Nikolai!
Not the Sheik. He's stuck in the passenger seat as Nikolai drives him crazy. Watch out, Nikolai!
"Watch out for what?" wonders Nikolai, who doesn't even notice the big truck blast past his rear end!
"Never mind the rear!" screams the Sheik. "I put my life in your hands every time you get behind the steering wheel!"
This poor woman thinks she's sitting waiting for thr bus. Well, she's about to get a whole lot more.
Like a free ride through the roof of the Sheikmobile - thanks to Nikolai's driving skill. All aboard!
She's so confused, she doesn't know who to thank! "Why don't you watch where you're driving, you lunatic?!"
Can’t she just sit back and enjoy the ride? Nikolai stomps on the brake - and sends the Sheik soaring…
Nikolai Volkoff
Nikolai Volkoff
Nikolai Volkoff
Nikolai Volkoff
…right through a billboard! Before Nikolai drives himn to the end of the line, Sheik decides to get his own license…
…after Bobby the Brain gives him a driving lesson. First thing, always remember to buckle your seatbelt.
No, no, Sheik! That's not your seatbelt! That's Bobby's belt!
Once the Sheik gets things rolling, Bobby wonders what he's gotten himself into!
"Watch out for that alley!" screams Bobby. "But why?" yells the Sheik, "There's plenty of room!"
Yes sir, Sheik. Plenty of room for half of Bobby's car and enough sparks to set the road on fire!
Bobby can't believe what's happening to his brand new car. But it's not over yet, not with the Sheik driving…
…right at a truck loaded with paint! The truck swerves away just in time to avoid a head-on collision.
But not before giving Bobby's new car an even newer paint job. Maybe the Sheik thought it needed one after the alley ride.
"Pull up and stop!" yells Bobby. But the Sheik thinks he's telling him to put up the top.
What's this in the middle of the street? This guy thinks he's high above the cars.
What's this in the middle of the street? This guy thinks he's high above the cars.
But when he sees the Sheik speeding with the top up, he knows that's he's just another low overhead.
But when he sees the Sheik speeding with the top up, he knows that's he's just another low overhead.
Low enough to rip a hole through Bobby's convertible roof! The Sheik's not ready to end the lesson yet.
Not until he's taken a shot at some parallel parking. There's plenty of room once he pushes these cars aside!
Bobby can’t believe what the Sheik has done. "How do you ever expect to get your driver's license?" he asks.
The Sheik tells Bobby that he'll get it the same way he gets everything else. He'll cheat!
The big day: The inspector climbs into the Sheikmobile and tells him to pull out and make a U-turn.
"No problem" says the Sheik. No problem, because under his hood he's got two tiny radio speakers…
…which are connected directly to Bobby the Brain's remote control driving unit!
As long as Bobby does the driving, it seems a sure bet that the Sheik will pass the test, no sweat!
But what's this? Nikolai wanders off and finds a boy flying an airplane - by remote control!
Nikolai wants to try it too, and the boy says sure. Pretty soon the plane is taking off for the wild blue yonder!
Nikolai flies an airplane as well as he drives a car! With all this driving and swooping, Bobby can’t concentrate.
"It’s time for a few tricks." decides Nikolai. When he flips a few switches to make the plane loop-de-loop…
…the driving inspector thinks the Sheik is testing for his pilot's license! Fasten your seatbelt!
It’s a lot of fun to send a model plane zipping around a tree in an empty park.
But not so much fun for the Sheik and the driving inspector - in the middle of a busy intersection!
But not so much fun for the Sheik and the driving inspector - in the middle of a busy intersection!
Bobby would help the Sheik out if he could, but he's got enough problems trying to dodge this pesky plane!
Bobby would help the Sheik out if he could, but he's got enough problems trying to dodge this pesky plane!
Time for Nikolai's fun to come to an end when the boy asks him to give back the model plane.
"Sure" says Nikolai. "Right after I bring it in for a landing. Can you see it coming?"
"Look at this" says Nikolai. It’s making a perfect three-point touchdown. Smooth, eh?
But not so smooth for the Sheikmobile. He only wants to know if he'll get his driver's license now.
Captain Lou Albano
Captain Lou Albano
Captain Lou Albano
Captain Lou Albano
"Driver's license?" shouts the inspector, "I'll make sure you never get a license in this city as long as I live!"
Now the Sheik only wants to know one thing: How did Nikolai get his license when he drives worse than the Sheik?
"Simple" says Nikolai, "I took my test in the frozen Siberian wasteland, where there's nothing to hit for miles!"
